entries.definition: characterized by anger
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The formal word for a short fuse; it condemns a standing disposition.

entries.definition: in an overbearing manner
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The adverb of *overbearing*: the weight metaphor is exact - the other person is pressed down, not persuaded.

entries.definition: speak in a blustering or scornful manner
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Inflation rather than pride: the thing is made to seem larger than it is.

entries.definition: ill-mannered and coarse and contemptible in behavior or appearance
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Ill-manners as a settled character, and contemptible with it.

entries.definition: derived by logic, without observed facts
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal and academic; the adverb of reasoning from principle rather than observation.
examples: He ruled the idea out a priori.

entries.definition: willing to face danger
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Courage as endurance - staying in when it hurts.

entries.definition: lacking subtlety and insight
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The harshest here, and it borrows the vocabulary of disability to do its work.

entries.definition: resembling a dog; especially in devotion
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Devotion with the dignity taken out; praise and belittlement in the same word.

entries.definition: ill-mannered and coarse and contemptible in behavior or appearance
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The alternative spelling, equally cutting.

entries.definition: in a corrupt and deceitful manner
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The adverb of *dishonest*: the plain word for it, and still an accusation - it names a settled disposition to cheat, not one bad day.
examples: he acted dishonestly when he gave the contract to his best friend

entries.definition: socially correct in behavior
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Credits the upbringing; the compliment reaches past the person to whoever raised them.

entries.definition: in an subtle, cunning manner
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The adverb of *foxy*: the animal metaphor, and easily confused with the unrelated sense meaning attractive.

entries.definition: having a rasping or grating sound
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The rarer and shriller variant, and it sounds like what it means.

entries.definition: marked by deliberate deceptiveness especially by pretending one set of feelings and acting under the influence of another
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flatter, less quotable cousin of two-faced; the same charge with none of the sting.
examples: a double-faced infernal traitor and schemer

entries.definition: in the manner of a beast
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The adverb of *brutish*: coarse rather than violent: it says unrefined more than it says cruel.

entries.definition: in a naively innocent manner
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The adverb of *innocent*: praise with a shadow: the same word can mean unspoiled or unprepared.

entries.definition: made of inferior workmanship and materials
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Shoddy goods and the hard sell that moves them; it doubts the seller as much as the thing.
examples: cheapjack moviemaking … that feeds on the low taste of the mob

entries.definition: willing to give and share unstintingly
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain, unqualified praise - it credits both the giving and the spirit behind it.
examples: She was generous with both money and time.

entries.definition: worn away as by water or ice or wind
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Geological and neutral; erosion is a process, not a fault.

entries.definition: without mercy or pity
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The everyday word, and the one business writing quietly turns into a compliment.

entries.definition: in a terrible manner
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The adverb of *rotten*: thoroughly bad, with a hint of moral distaste.

entries.definition: a rattling sound as of hard things striking together
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Small hard things in quantity; kitchens and typewriters.

entries.definition: showing or motivated by sympathy and understanding and generosity
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Splits in two: charitable giving is warm, a *charitable interpretation* is faintly condescending.
examples: was charitable in his opinions of others

entries.definition: in an intelligent manner
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The adverb of *intelligent*: the neutral, respectable word - approving without flourish.
examples: she acted intelligently in this difficult situation

entries.definition: express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: An old sense surviving mainly in plaintive and plaintiff; to complain formally.

entries.definition: characterized by careless unconcern
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The gravest here - it implies danger, and appears in law for that reason.

entries.definition: marked by skill in deception
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Half-admiring when said of animals and plans, condemning when said of people.
examples: cunning men often pass for wise

entries.definition: offensively self-assured or given to exercising usually unwarranted power
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Mock-grand, and the mockery is doing the condemning.

entries.definition: having a difficult and contrary disposition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Difficulty over small things, and comic rather than frightening.

entries.definition: characterized by elegance or refinement or accomplishment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Enormously overworked elsewhere, but in this sense it is genuine praise.
examples: looking fine in her Easter suit

entries.definition: distorted and unnatural in shape or size; abnormal and hideous
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Distorted to the point of unsettling - beyond plain ugliness.
examples: tales of grotesque serpents eight fathoms long that churned the seas

entries.definition: exhibiting childlike simplicity and credulity
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Describes the face rather than the judgement; it can be wonder or it can be folly.

entries.definition: eagerly desirous
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: This sense means *eagerly desirous* - *anxious to help* - and is easily misread as worry.
examples: anxious to see the new show at the museum

entries.definition: exceptionally bad or displeasing
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt and total - among the strongest everyday condemnations.

entries.definition: heartily friendly and congenial
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Backhanded: friendly to everyone, and so to no one in particular.

entries.definition: in an subtle, cunning manner
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The adverb of *knavish*: names the person a knave; the word has aged into costume drama.

entries.definition: lavishly elegant and refined
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise at the limit, and it implies the observer noticed every detail.

entries.definition: genuinely; with authority
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The adverb of *genuine*: warm without being showy: it says a thing is what it claims, and that this was worth saying.

entries.definition: with perseverance
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The adverb of *persevering*: the same steadiness against resistance; it presumes there was reason to stop.

entries.definition: look towards one's back
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The literal version, used where the wistful sense would confuse.

entries.definition: very angry
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Comic and deflating - it makes the anger look faintly ridiculous.

entries.definition: marked by meekness or modesty; not arrogant or prideful
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise when chosen, plain description when not - *humble origins* passes no judgement.
examples: essentially humble … and self-effacing, he achieved the highest formal honors and distinctions

entries.definition: elegant and sumptuous
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Clipped and fashion-trade; it names a look rather than a quality.

entries.definition: make off with belongings of others
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Repeated small thefts - the pettiness is part of the charge.

entries.definition: in a thankful manner; with thanks
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The adverb of *thankful*: carries a trace of prayer - thanks owed to providence as much as to a person.

entries.definition: find fault with; express criticism of; point out real or perceived flaws
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Methodical rather than angry: the thing is taken to pieces on purpose.

entries.definition: showing extreme courage; especially of actions courageously undertaken in desperation as a last resort
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Courage beyond what could be asked of anyone.
examples: they took heroic measures to save his life

entries.definition: (used colloquially) overly conceited or arrogant
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Light, colloquial mockery of someone's swollen self-opinion.
